image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a ceramic coffee cup filled with a latte or cappuccino, featuring foam art residue. The cup has a white interior and exterior with a blue rim and small red floral patterns. A C-shaped handle is visible on the left side. In the background, there are blurred objects including a glass bottle, a green can, a milk carton, and a patterned tin.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cup and distinguish it from bowls or mugs based on fine-grained features.
To verify the structural integrity of the handle attachment and ensure the rim is a continuous, closed loop without melting or fusion artifacts.
To assess the realism of the liquid surface texture, foam consistency, and background blur (bokeh) for signs of AI generation.
To check the legibility of text on the background milk carton and cans, as AI often fails to render coherent text in complex backgrounds.

focus_areas: Handle attachment points for structural plausibility
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the liquid foam and the cup rim. AI images often struggle with the meniscus or the way foam adheres to the ceramic edge. Also, scrutinize the background text; if it is gibberish, it is a strong indicator of AI generation despite the foreground quality.
